# Project Language Policy

All work in this repository must be written in English.

- Use English for source code, identifiers, comments, documentation, examples, Storybook stories, user-facing text, commit messages, pull requests, issue-related content, and Copilot responses about this project.
- Do not write Spanish or any other language in new or modified project content.
- When updating existing content, translate any touched non-English text into English rather than preserving or extending it.
- Keep technical names, API names, package names, URLs, and quoted third-party text unchanged when they are required for correctness.
- Before finishing a task, check that all newly added or modified text follows this policy.
